Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL1649059. Join activities to assays and target_dictionary filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL1649059. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain canonical SMILES. Filter rows where standard_type is IC50, standard_relation is '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
